description: Localisation et statut des velos Flexo is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data Orléans Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Kéolis Orléans Métropole. Statut et position des vélos dans la métropole. Coverage: Orléans Métropole. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements, Equipements publics, Transition écologique. Its keywords are velo, mobilité. The portal shows 100 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-orleans-metropole-fr-portal.
